units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 19b:9">B. Bath. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>במ׳</he> when the straw is foul.

senses.gloss: (noun) מ׳, מְתוּנְתָּא f. reeky, infiltrated earth. Ib. 18ᵃ מ׳ קשה וכ׳ ground infiltrated (with urine &c.) is injurious to the wall. Ib. 19ᵃ היזיקא דמ׳ the damage caused by &c.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 47b">Pes. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>במתונא</he> Ar. a. Ms. M. 2 (ed. <he>במתונתא</he>; Ms. M. 1 <he>במתינה</he>) it means swampy earth (which cannot be crushed to powder).
